_meta.role: Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, building and deploying computer vision and deep learning models for real-time perception on embedded and edge platforms. Deployed a TensorRT-optimized YOLO detector on NVIDIA Jetson at a 5.2x speedup inside a vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system, and designed end-to-end CV pipelines spanning U-Net segmentation and transformer fine-tuning. Proficient in Python, C++, PyTorch, and TensorFlow with direct experience in GPU kernel optimization and ROS-based robotic manipulation.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline using bit manipulation, averaging, and a custom wavelet bank, raising PSNR from 65 (homography baseline) to 86 while reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) via PyTorch/HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver the full pipeline within the 6-week window.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.

Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.

Resolved 11 integration failures; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency, deployed as a hardened systemd service (auto-restart, non-root isolation) with static IP networking.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels (memory coalescing, constant memory); ran at 49.2ms vs 77.5ms CPU TorchScript baseline — ~35% speedup with identical accuracy.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B (profiled with pynvml); benchmarked on HellaSwag/GSM8K/ARC at <1% accuracy degradation — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B, validated against MoveIt/RViz in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic; executed collision-free pick-and-place on the physical UR5e (<2mm repeatability).
